hooks.name: Check Backend Port & Report Startup Commands
hooks.description: When a file under backend/ or frontend/ is saved, checks if backend port 8000 is active and reports startup commands for both services.

action.command: powershell -NoProfile -Command "try { $conn = Test-NetConnection -ComputerName localhost -Port 8000 -WarningAction SilentlyContinue; if ($conn.TcpTestSucceeded) { Write-Output '[OK] Backend port 8000 is active and responding.'; Write-Output ''; Write-Output '--- Startup Commands ---'; Write-Output 'Backend: .\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000'; Write-Output 'Frontend: npm run dev (in frontend/ folder)'; } else { Write-Output '[WARN] Backend port 8000 is NOT responding.'; Write-Output ''; Write-Output 'Please start the backend first:'; Write-Output '  cd backend'; Write-Output '  .\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000'; Write-Output ''; Write-Output 'Then start frontend:'; Write-Output '  cd frontend'; Write-Output '  npm run dev'; } } catch { Write-Output '[ERROR] Could not check port 8000. Please verify manually.'; Write-Output ''; Write-Output 'Backend: .\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000'; Write-Output 'Frontend: npm run dev'; }"
